text: DAOs are free to organize as they choose, and those that fail to find the right incentives for productive behavior will certainly go extinct, because the feedback loop that includes customers outside the DAO punishes unproductive DAOs by loss of fees.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Reputation for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782210
